summary: Obfuscated remote-agent runtime with PTY/SSH primitives and self-replacing update channel
details: @whalent/agent-core@0.3.278 ships a 13.7 MB dist/index.cjs declared as both `main` and `bin` that is fully obfuscated with obfuscator.io (rotating string-array with 106,734 entries, control-flow flattening, hex identifiers). All destination URLs and command strings are hidden behind the string-array decoder, so the endpoints the agent contacts and the commands it runs are not statically discoverable. The bundle combines network-inbound primitives (WebSocket, net.createConnection) with terminal/shell primitives (node-pty onData/write, spawn, ssh2) and references loopback RDP/VNC endpoints (127.0.0.1:3389,:5900,:5901) — the structural shape of a remote-terminal agent that pipes input received from a network peer into a PTY on the installer's host. The package README also states this runtime `is the package replaced by remote daemon upgrades`, and the bundle contains fs write / chmod primitives alongside the WebSocket transport, matching a remote-controlled self-upgrade path in which a remote daemon can swap the on-disk runtime with attacker-chosen replacement code outside the npm publish channel. Installing and running this package grants a remote party the ability to execute shell commands on the host and to replace the executed runtime bytes without a further install-time consent step.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
